issues.desc: checklist.json CHK-010 context refers to "the completeness-critic's two MAJOR holes" but neither term ("completeness-critic", "MAJOR hole") is defined or used anywhere else in background.md, index.json, or the cited docs/requirements/decisions/milestone-ledger-status-review-findings.md. A fresh reader of CHK-010 in isolation cannot tell what a completeness-critic is or what makes a hole MAJOR vs any other severity; the rest of CHK-010's context is otherwise self-explanatory and this does not block understanding the actual required work (stale-evidence + second-DONE-gate reconciliation), so this is advisory only.
